- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh: lines 51, 56 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new CONFLICT_RESOLVED short-circuit comment (line 51: "Running Codex against an empty conflict set is the known hallucination hazard…") and the log message (line 56: "skipping Codex resolver") both call the script "Codex", but the file header (lines 1-3) and the surrounding code (`OPENCODE_HELPERS_PATH`, `OPENCODE_CONFIG_WRITER_PATH`, "run the OpenCode resolver") explicitly identify it as the OpenCode-based resolver.
  WHY: No runtime failure — this is purely a documentation/logging inconsistency. But it matters: (a) operator-facing log lines in the workflow output will name the wrong resolver when the manifest short-circuit fires, defeating the log-as-documentation invariant the script already follows elsewhere; (b) a developer grepping for "Codex resolver" to find this script will not find it; (c) the consistency invariant holds for every other mention of the resolver in this file (header, env-var names, helper paths). Single-line fix: replace "Codex" with "the resolver" (or "the OpenCode resolver") on both lines so the comment and log line match the rest of the file.
